verdict.rationale: The repo publishes itself as a Claude Code plugin marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add kaankiziltug/logo-design-skill`), so a developer can add that listing and see the logo-design plugin before running `/plugin install`. However, the listing holds only this one skill, and the browsing UI belongs to the host platform. The searchable 1,400-logo library is an adjacent feature (logos, not skills) and earns no credit. missing for 10: a multi-skill registry, leaderboard or catalog listing; documented search or browse of available skills; evidence of listing in any third-party skill directory.
